claim: Held-out synthetic placements and perturbation probes on reused real regression-gate ride backgrounds; NOT an independent real dataset or real-positive recall estimate.

exclusion_policy: Exclude the ENTIRE four named recordings, not merely these intervals. Also exclude every other short bag and set O. All selected windows are from new_data. Definitions, not outcome tables, establish exclusions. Additional A/E shape variants and whole-bag probes are thereby excluded too.

window_policy.selection: Fixed four windows, chosen from DATASET.md input scene hints (splits 22,55,129-134,176-180); no scene or category is asserted by those hints. Geometry-only confirmation below. No search outside these windows and no substitution.
window_policy.intervals: [start,end), global=51*numeric_split+local; each window is 714 consecutive message indices with 60 warm-up messages before insert. Validate each split has 51 messages; fail closed if not.
window_policy.time: Use bag receipt timestamps from *_stamps.json, not wall clock or sensor's epoch-2000 header. Do not synthesize missing frames or compress gaps. Preserve original header stamp separately for audit.
window_policy.category_rule: Before any detector call, classify each fixed window by the deterministic geometry rules in README section 3. Multiple labels allowed. If not confirmed or geometry unavailable, retain the same window and label unclassified_fixed_fallback, never invent a station/switch/curve. No replacement or extension for insufficient travel, gaps, weak rails, poor visibility or misses.
window_policy.warmup: Fresh detector state for EVERY case/variant/control; replay all 60 preceding messages without injection (every other message for 5Hz). Never reuse a detector state or baseline result between cases.

randomization.algorithm: SHA-256 counter PRF, not Python hash/random: H(tag)=int.from_bytes(sha256(UTF8('20261015|'+tag)).digest()[:8], 'big'); lateral_draw_mm=H(window_id+'/'+shape_id+'/lateral')%1801-900; case_seed=H(case_id+'/seed')%2147483647; crossing_direction=-1 if H(window_id+'/'+shape_id+'/direction')%2==0 else +1.
randomization.ray_randomness: u(tag)=H(tag)/2**64. Background ray tag: background/window_id/variant_id/global_frame/ring/azimuth_column/purpose. Synthetic ray tag: object/case_id/variant_id/global_frame/ring/azimuth_column/purpose. Purposes are drop, dark, noise1, noise2; duplicate returns share the unique-ray tag. Thus background perturbations are identical in every paired control. Gaussian noise uses Box-Muller sqrt(-2*ln(max(u_noise1,2**-64)))*cos(2*pi*u_noise2). No sequential shared RNG; scheduling cannot change draws.
randomization.pairing: Approach and crossing share the same lateral draw. Rail side follows draw sign (zero chooses left). Pole sides are fixed; plank draw is divided by 9 to remain across both rails. Always retain the original +/-900 mm draw in metadata. Variant draws include variant_id; geometry, placement and background are otherwise paired.

motions.approach: One world-static object with front-face route distance d0=230.0 m at insert, positioned using ONLY background ICP trajectory and independent rail/bed geometry. Stop replay after full window, including object passage if available. Never move the scene to follow a detector axis.
motions.crossing: Same longitudinal station and d0=230 m. t100 is first timestamp at which independent remaining route distance <=100 m. Lateral y(t)=anchor_lateral+direction*clip(1.0*(t-t100),-4,+4) m. Fixed longitudinal station, 1.0 m/s crossing; clamp only the displacement, not anchor. Replay full window. Missing t100 => incomplete_crossing, no substitute. Pole +/-0.8 refers to the anchor at t100; rail support refers to the initial frozen rail-height plane, not rail-snapping a moving object.
motions.ground_truth: Store full object-to-world and world-to-sensor SE(3), front/centre/back route stations, oriented bounding box, analytic primitive and timestamps per frame. Route distance is arc length along the background trajectory, NOT detector-reported range. All ray intersections use Euclidean range.

geometry.source: Background points only; fixed sensor-to-vehicle mapping X=-sensor_y,Y=sensor_x,Z=sensor_z. No detector calibration, tracks, labels, object outputs, intensity-trained model or baseline JSON. See README section 3 for frozen ICP and rail/bed/category selection rules.
geometry.icp: Open3D CPU float64 point-to-plane current onto previous, 3<X<80 m, |Y|<6 m; voxel=0.15 m, normals radius=0.6/max_nn=20, max correspondence=0.5 m, max_iteration=40, relative_fitness=1e-6, relative_rmse=1e-6; identity first guess, previous transform thereafter; one thread; retain full SE(3) and fitness/RMSE. No positive clipping or smoothing of motion.
geometry.bad_pair: fitness<0.30, RMSE>0.25 m, <2000 downsampled points, timestamp gap>0.25 s, nonfinite transform or translation speed>30 m/s => invalid pair; do not carry forward a guessed dx. Any invalid pair from insert to the required station => geometry_blocked for that scene; retain all cases and reasons.
geometry.dependency_record: Before detector invocation freeze geometry file, point input SHA-256s, exact Python/NumPy/Open3D versions, CPU/platform, one-thread settings and serialized transforms. A fresh runner must create a detector-free ICP adapter: stock icp_odometry.py constructs NodeReplica and stock range_test.py uses detector baseline geometry; neither is an acceptable geometry builder unchanged.

visibility.grid: Measured ring elevations and per-frame azimuth phase from background points only; 0.1 degree columns; preserve two return slots. Do not fabricate empty/missing rings. Missing ring geometry => visibility_geometry_missing, retain case.
visibility.range: No injected return beyond 210.0 m or below 2.5 m. Full frame ray grid intersected analytically with cuboid/cylinder; nearest positive surface intersection only. Match real +/-50 degree usable FOV by retaining only azimuth slots present in source. The 230 m start intentionally includes a blind approach.
visibility.occlusion: Existing return in same ring/column strictly nearer than synthetic hit minus 0.02 m occludes it. Replace farther returns, preserve nearer ones, duplicate a synthetic echo into the two original slots; count one unique ray for visibility, never count duplicate echoes twice. No carving unrelated background points.
visibility.reference_visible: At least one unique unoccluded, in-FOV, in-range ray before dropout/noise. Also report >=3-ray visibility. Reference visibility is shared across paired variants; never remove a miss because perturbation removed its returns. Zero-reference-visible cases remain in the full denominator as sensor_unobservable.
visibility.envelope: Independent geometry envelope |lateral|<=1.05 m and rail-relative height in [0,3.0] m. Hazard frame iff the analytic object intersects this envelope AND front route distance in [5,230] m. A bed box wholly below rail is nonhazard, even if visible. Partial occlusion, track curvature, outside-envelope crossing and truncation must be logged, never culled.
visibility.bed_controls: In each window, two paired 0.3x0.3x0.1 m cuboids (approach/crossing): top fixed 0.05 m BELOW the independently fitted rail, bottom=-0.15 m, at the bed030 draw. Negative geometry probes, not assertions of actual bed height. Also replay unmodified empty background. Report all STOPs, including those attributable to background, with empty-control pairing; never subtract a positive miss.

variants.operation: rotate complete sensor cloud +2 degrees pitch, including warm-up
rotate complete sensor cloud -2 degrees pitch, including warm-up
rotate complete sensor cloud +2 degrees roll, including warm-up
rotate complete sensor cloud +3 degrees yaw, including warm-up
independently remove 30% of unique return rays, whole scene including warm-up; both duplicate echoes share decision
add zero-mean Gaussian radial noise sigma=0.02 m to each unique return, whole scene including warm-up; duplicate echoes share noise
keep global indices (i-start)%2==0, preserve timestamps and physical object path; no interpolated frames
remove exact duplicate xyz,intensity,ring returns, stable first occurrence
synthetic reflectivity=10; synthetic unique-ray survival p=1 for range<=120 m, p=1-(range-120)/160 for 120<range<=200, p=0.5 for 200<range<=210; explicit model assumption, not measured sensor recall

variant_policy: Full 84 cases x 11 variants=924 independently reset replays, including empty/negative controls. One-factor variants only. Analytic intersection/occlusion first, then synthetic dark model, then full-scene ray deletion/noise, then vehicle-frame rotation Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll), then dedup/temporal selection as applicable. Right-handed active rotations about vehicle axes; transform GT consistently into reported evaluation frame. Do not alter physical placement or refit geometry for a variant.

metrics.match: A hazard hit requires reference visibility, frame decision STOP AND a reported STOP-producing detection whose box overlaps the independently transformed GT lateral interval with 0.25 m margin and whose front-distance error <=max(2.0 m,0.03*r_gt)+object_length/2. For matching, front distance is minimum vehicle-frame X over the analytic object, and r_gt is Euclidean near-surface range; route arc distance d_gt is reported separately and must not be substituted for vehicle X on a curve. An unrelated global STOP, CAUTION, clear_distance or stale track without matching detection is not a hit. Compute geometric matches also on negative controls to count false STOPs. Save all matches and unmatched STOPs.
metrics.first_stop: First chronological matched STOP in a hazard frame; report frame id, bag timestamp, front route distance m and Euclidean near-surface range m. Report first_visible identically. No match => null plus reason, never 0 m or deletion.
metrics.held90: For each chronological hazard frame k with reference visibility, take the suffix of ALL hazard frames j>=k through last hazard frame in that case (invisible frames count as misses). Candidate qualifies if suffix spans >=1.0 s, has >=10 scheduled frames (>=5 at 5Hz), and matched_STOP_count/scheduled_count>=0.90. held90 is route distance at earliest qualifying k; otherwise null. Use actual timestamps, no gaps fabricated; a source gap>0.25 s makes a hold spanning it invalid. Report denominator, fraction, last hazard frame and truncation; do not call a short crossing a successful hold.
metrics.denominators: Report primary 4-window macro and per-class/per-motion/per-variant tables; list every case. Pole signs stay separate and share class new_pole. Report all scheduled cases, hazard cases, reference-visible cases, >=3-ray cases, sensor_unobservable, geometry_blocked, below_rail_negative, incomplete_approach, incomplete_crossing, execution_error separately. No pooling frames as independent rides; no independent-real-set confidence claim.
metrics.misses: Every hazard frame with no matched STOP is retained in frame JSONL, with visibility, ray count, GT, detector decision/detections, geometry/category flags and variant. Every null first_stop or held90 has a row in misses.json/csv, including technical/unobservable cases. No post-hoc class collapse, placement changes or dropping blocked cases.
metrics.controls: For each empty and below-rail case: STOP frames, matched-object STOP frames, episodes (consecutive STOP with gap<=0.25 s), duration seconds, first STOP, paired excess STOP frames/episodes versus same-window same-variant empty. Do not attribute background STOP to an injected object without matching geometry.
metrics.perturbations: For each case report paired first_stop and held90 deltas in m against base only when both exist; missing one => explicit lost/gained/null, never zero-impute. Publish per-case rows, median deltas and counts of null/lost/gained by class. No best-variant headline or threshold optimization. No pre-registered aggregate pass claim; this is a descriptive test battery.

execution.when: ONCE on verified FINAL shipped seal around 2026-10-21, by another fresh-context agent with no detector tuning. No detector, range_test.py, probe.py or held-out evaluation at registration.
execution.seal: Before any detector run: git clean intended state, record final commit/tag/image digest and explicit final seal manifest; run python scripts/detector_freeze.py verify --manifest <FINAL_MANIFEST> and archive PASS log. Do not accept the default old manifest implicitly. Repeat verification after the single batch; native/config/sealed files may not change.
execution.adapter: Freeze a geometry-only scene manifest and audited external evaluation adapter BEFORE first output. Reuse range_test/probe input semantics, ray casting and node-faithful detection path, but supply immutable independent GT instead of invoking their detector-baseline placement. Run the registered range and probe matrix once as a single batch. No unmodified stock invocation that creates *_baseline.json for placement. See README handoff.
execution.order: Lexicographic case_id, then variant_id; sequential CPU one-thread reference. All scene/metadata hashes fixed before execution. Empty controls are explicit cases, not a hidden tuning pass.
execution.failure: Write-once batch with one invocation per case/variant; never overwrite or rerun a failed or disappointing row. Interrupted/missing rows => execution_error/not_executed in final results. Any infrastructure rerun needs a new visibly amended protocol and loses the original once-only claim; no replacement backgrounds or cases.
execution.artifacts: Only after the batch: results.json, results.md, all 924 case/variant rows, frame outputs, every miss, controls, geometry/dependency/source hashes, manifest and both verify logs. Record registration commit and geometry/runner commits. A subsequent tuning change makes this battery development data; no second held-out headline.
